target_bid.description: Expected purchase price for Gransdalen 29. Increasing this raises total acquisition cost and increases pressure on financing and renovation headroom.

closing_cost_pct.description: Percentage allowance for transaction costs such as legal, fees, and duties. Increasing it reduces cash headroom at closing.

bank_loan.description: Debt available from the bank. Increasing it helps cover the purchase but increases interest and repayment pressure.

own_funds.description: Equity the church can contribute. Increasing it lowers the funding gap and future debt burden, but ties up more cash immediately.

nominal_rate.description: Approximate borrowing rate used in the high-level debt-service estimate. Increasing it raises annual financing pressure.

amort_years.description: Repayment period used in the rough debt-service estimate. Shorter periods increase annual payments but reduce debt faster.

cash_buffer.description: Cash reserve kept aside after acquisition for safety. Increasing it improves resilience but reduces funds available for renovation and overlap costs.

annual_member_cashflow.description: Annual free cash left after normal church staff and operating costs are already covered. This is the amount available to support the property strategy.

lease_lock_in.description: How much current leases restrict your timing and flexibility. Higher values mean less freedom to repurpose space quickly.

conversion_uncertainty.description: How uncertain you are about layout changes, structure, and hidden building work. Higher values raise overall project risk.

approvals_risk.description: How difficult regulatory approval and compliance may be. Higher values increase expected delay and cost risk.

regulation_risk.description: How uncertain lawful use, zoning, assembly permission, or other regulatory permission may be. Higher values mean more risk that the intended church use is delayed, restricted, or blocked.

financing_pressure.description: How tight the financing picture feels. Higher values mean less room for surprises in purchase price, timing, or cost escalation.

income_dependency.description: How much the project depends on rent or shared-use income. Higher values mean the case weakens more if tenants or events underperform.

market_buffer.description: How much price cushion you believe exists. Higher values improve resilience because the purchase feels less stretched.

management_complexity.description: How hard the transition will be to manage operationally. Higher values mean more execution risk and more chance of friction or delay.

contingency_cover.description: How strong your fallback reserves and mitigations are. Higher values reduce effective project risk.

hall_area.description: Estimated area to convert into the main hall zone. Increasing it raises cost, but may also improve capacity and usefulness.

hall_light.description: Low-cost hall adaptation rate. Increasing it raises the light scenario total.

hall_medium.description: Mid-range hall conversion rate. Increasing it raises the mid scenario total.

hall_heavy.description: High intervention hall rate for more serious rebuilding and systems work.

office_area.description: Estimated office, classroom, or weekday-use area to improve. Increasing it raises cost but can increase flexibility and income options.

basement_area.description: Estimated basement or support-space area to improve. Increasing it raises cost but may improve storage and back-of-house operations.

specialist_fees_pct.description: Architect, engineer, consultant, and similar professional costs. Higher values increase every renovation scenario.

contingency_pct.description: Reserve for surprises and omissions. Higher values increase budget but lower the chance of being underfunded.

fixed_fire_hvac.description: Allowance for ventilation, fire, code, and compliance-heavy work. Increasing it materially raises total project cost.

technical_catchup.description: Allowance for roof, drainage, electrical, water ingress, and other base-building issues that are not part of room fit-out.

tenant_turnover.description: Allowance for making areas usable after tenant change, demolition, strip-out, partitions, cleaning, and practical adaptation work.

site_parking.description: Allowance for outdoor works, access improvements, markings, lighting, or other site-related upgrades.

furniture_av.description: Allowance for chairs, AV, loose furniture, and non-building fit-out items.

must_do_before_use_pct.description: Share of the renovation program that must be funded before the building can realistically start being used for the intended church program.

income_source_index.description: Choose whether income scenarios use the whole building or a second-floor-only case after giving the first floor to church use.

contracted_rent.description: Current annual rent already contracted. Increasing it improves transition cash support and debt coverage.

vacant_upside.description: Additional income you may be able to create from vacant or underused areas. Increasing it improves upside but may rely on execution.

second_floor_contracted_rent.description: Current annual contracted rent visible on the second floor only, based on the prospect's listed rents for the medical center, Makeupediaa, and the psychologist.

second_floor_vacant_upside.description: Indicative additional annual upside from the vacant 31 m² second-floor office, using the implied current second-floor rent level.

exclude_hall_income_when_second_floor_on.description: When enabled, hall/event income is forced to zero in the second-floor-only scenario because the first floor is assumed to be dedicated to church use rather than rent-producing events.

retained_lease_income_pct.description: How much of current lease income survives the transition. Lower values weaken cash support during changeover.

expected_collection_pct.description: Expected cash collection quality. Lower values mean income on paper turns into less money in hand.

hall_rental_income.description: Expected yearly hall or event income. Increasing it improves the income case, but may be uncertain if demand is not proven.

classroom_office_income.description: Expected yearly room, classroom, office, or counseling income.

parking_income.description: Smaller supporting income such as parking or other ancillary uses.

operating_cost_ratio.description: Share of gross income lost to operating costs. Increasing it reduces the net amount available for debt and project support.

scenario_index.description: Choose the floor-opening scenario to test. More aggressive scenarios increase potential capacity but assume more conversion freedom.

min_space_per_person.description: Area allowed per person in a dense layout. Lower values increase capacity but may be less realistic or less comfortable.

max_space_per_person.description: Area allowed per person in a more comfortable layout. Higher values reduce capacity but improve circulation and comfort.

weekly_major_events.description: Number of major gatherings per week. Higher values increase hall utilization assumptions.

support_room_source_index.description: Choose whether usable support rooms are assumed to come mainly from the basement, the second floor, or both.

basement_usable_rooms.description: Working estimate of usable support rooms sourced from the basement, based on the prospect's mention of reception, dining room, kitchen, offices, and other rooms.

second_floor_usable_rooms.description: Working estimate of usable support rooms sourced from the second-floor sketch and prospect. The sketch visibly supports roughly 8 to 10 usable secondary rooms before redesign.

small_rooms.description: Number of secondary rooms available for ministry, classes, or meetings. Higher values improve weekday flexibility.

sacred_room_area.description: First-floor area reserved for a dedicated sacred room or tabot space rather than the main congregation hall.

avg_room_capacity.description: Average occupancy capacity in support rooms.

weekday_utilization_hours.description: Estimated weekly use hours for smaller rooms. Higher values imply more weekday program intensity.

principal.description: Principal borrowed from the bank. Increasing it improves purchase capacity but raises repayment and interest burden.

establishment_fee.description: One-off fee charged when the loan is set up.

monthly_term_fee.description: Monthly bank fee added to each payment.

rate.description: Nominal bank interest rate. Increasing it raises the interest portion of every payment.

years.description: Loan duration. Shorter terms increase monthly principal payments but reduce debt faster.

sale_delay_months.description: Delay before the current building is sold. Increasing it delays the benefit of any prepayment and keeps interest higher for longer.

sale_prepayment_share.description: Planning assumption for how much of the outstanding loan is repaid when the sale occurs. Higher values lower later interest and payment burden.

use_sidebar_loan_used.description: When enabled, the Mortgage Plan loan principal follows the actual bank loan used from the sidebar rather than a separate manual value.

use_sidebar_financing_terms.description: When enabled, the Mortgage Plan rate and loan term follow the sidebar financing assumptions so coverage and schedule views stay aligned.

include_sale_prepayment.description: Turn this on to model a lump-sum loan reduction when the current building is sold.

alna_sale_price.description: Expected gross sale price for Alnafetgata in the fallback path.

alna_sale_cost_pct.description: Broker, legal, and transaction cost deducted from the Alnafetgata sale before cash is available.

grans_income_waiting.description: Expected annual Gransdalen property income while Sebeka is still renting elsewhere and not yet using Gransdalen as the main worship site.

annual_external_hall_rent.description: Annual rent for the larger hall Sebeka would use instead of moving into Gransdalen immediately.

annual_rented_hall_staff.description: Annual staff cost for the rented-hall fallback path, aligned to the 2025 staff figure from the General Assembly report.

annual_rented_hall_running_cost.description: Other annual running cost of using a rented hall, such as storage, transport, cleaning, consumables, or service charges.

annual_reinnovation_spend.description: Annual budget reserved for phased reinnovation, design work, or municipality / approval work while Sebeka is not moving into Gransdalen yet.

annual_support_help.description: Optional annual grant, municipality support, or other external help used only in the support-assisted waiting path.

years_to_test.description: How many years of the fallback path to test.

use_income_tab_for_grans.description: When enabled, the Gransdalen property-income figure is pulled from the Income Generation tab's base-case gross income. Turn this off to enter a manual override.

grans_utilities.description: Annual utilities for Gransdalen such as electricity, heating, and water.

grans_cleaning.description: Cleaning, waste, and routine operational cost at Gransdalen.

grans_security.description: Security, alarm, and compliance-related running cost at Gransdalen.

grans_other.description: Any additional Gransdalen cost not already listed. Increasing it raises total carrying cost.

grans_contingency.description: Extra annual buffer for Gransdalen operating surprises. Increasing it raises prudence and cost at the same time.

grans_income_override.description: Annual property-related income from Gransdalen such as rent or paid use. Increasing it reduces net overlap pressure.

alna_staff.description: Annual staff cost attributed to Alnafetgata 2, seeded from the 2025 actual salary figure in the General Assembly report.

alna_cleaning.description: Cleaning, waste, and routine operational cost at Alnafetgata 2.

alna_other.description: Any additional Alnafetgata 2 cost not already listed.

alna_contingency.description: Extra annual buffer for Alnafetgata operating surprises. Increasing it raises prudence and cost at the same time.

alna_income.description: Annual property-related income still generated by Alnafetgata 2 during overlap.

overlap_months.description: How long both sites must be carried at the same time. Increasing it raises temporary double-running pressure.

duplicate_staffing.description: Extra staffing or management cost caused by running both properties during transition.

overlap_income_offset.description: Additional temporary income that offsets overlap pressure but is not already counted in the building income fields.
